duas.meaning: O Allah, bless them in what You have provided for them, and forgive them and have mercy on them.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 182 · Muslim 3/1615.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: To one who intends to give food or drink
duas.title: Chapter: To one who intends to give food or drink
duas.arabicTitle: الدعاء إذا أراد الطعام أو الشراب
duas.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ أَطْعِمْ مَن أَطْعَمَني، وَاسْقِ مَن سقاني
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma aṭ`im man aṭ`amanī wasqi man saqānī.
duas.meaning: O Allah, feed the one who has fed me, and give drink to the one who has given me drink.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 183 · Muslim 3/126.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: When breaking fast in someone’s home
duas.title: Chapter: When breaking fast in someone’s home
duas.arabicTitle: الدعاء إذا أفطر عند أهل بيت
duas.arabic: أَفْطَـرَ عِنْدَكُم الصّـائِمونَ وَأَكَلَ طَعامَـكُمُ الأبْـرار، وَصَلَّـتْ عَلَـيْكُمُ الملائِكَـة
duas.transliteration: Afṭara `indakumuṣ-ṣā'imūn, wa akala ṭa`āmakumu ‘l-'abrār, wa ṣallat `alaykumu ‘l-malā'ikah.
duas.meaning: With you, those who are fasting have broken their fast, you have fed those who are righteous, and the angels recite their prayers upon you.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 184 · Abu Dawud 3/367, Ibn Majah 1/556, An-Nasa'i, 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah 296-8. Al-Albani graded it authentic in Sahih Abu Dawud 2/730.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: By one fasting when presented with food and does not break his fast
duas.title: Chapter: By one fasting when presented with food and does not break his fast
duas.arabicTitle: دعاء الصائم إذا حضر الطعام ولم يفطر
duas.arabic: (إِذَا دُعِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيُجِبْ، فَإِنْ كَانَ صَائِماً فَلْيُصَلِّ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُفْطِراً فَلْيَطْعَمْ) ، وَمَعْنَى فَلْيُصَلِّ أَيْ فَلْيَدْعُ.
duas.meaning: When you are invited (to eat) then reply to the invitation. If you are fasting then invoke Allah's blessings (on your host), and if you are not fasting then eat.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 185 · Muslim 2/1054.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: When insulted while fasting
duas.title: Chapter: When insulted while fasting
duas.arabicTitle: ما يقول الصائم إذا سابه أحد
duas.arabic: إِنِّي صَائِمٌ، إِنِّي صَائِمٌ
duas.transliteration: Innī ṣā'im, innī ṣā'im.
duas.meaning: I am fasting. I am fasting.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 186 · Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-BAri 4/103, Muslim 2/806.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Upon seeing the early or premature fruit
duas.title: Chapter: Upon seeing the early or premature fruit
duas.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ بارِكْ لَنا في ثَمَـرِنا، وَبارِكْ لَنا في مَدينَتِنـا، وَبارِكْ لَنا في صاعِنـا، وَبارِكْ لَنا في مُدِّنا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma bārik lanā fī thamarinā, wa bārik lanā fī madīnatinā wa bārik lanā fī ṣā`inā, wa bārik lanā fī muddinā.
duas.meaning: O Allah, bless us in our dates and bless us in our town, bless us in our Sa' and in our Mudd.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 187 · Muslim 2/1000 (Sa' and Mudd are both dry measures used for agricultural produce by the Arabs in the Prophet's time. Of the two, the So.' was the larger measure.) (Translator)

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Upon sneezing
duas.title: Chapter: Upon sneezing
duas.arabic: إِذَا عَطَسَ أَحَدُكُم فَلْيَقُلِ (الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ)، وَلْيَقُلْ لَهُ أَخُوهُ أَوْ صَاحِبُهُ: (يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ)، فَإِذَا قَالَ لَهُ: (يَرحَمُكَ اللَّهُ)، فَلْيَقُلْ: (يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ)
duas.transliteration: When you sneeze , then say :
duas.meaning: When you sneeze, then say: All praises and thanks are to Allah. Your companion should say: May Allah have mercy upon you. When someone says Yarḥamukallāh to you then you should say: May Allah guide you and set your affairs in order.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 188 · Al-Bukhari 7/125.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: When a disbeliever praises Allah after sneezing
duas.title: Chapter: When a disbeliever praises Allah after sneezing
duas.arabicTitle: ما يقالُ للكافر إذا عطس فحمد الله
duas.arabic: يَهْـديكُـمُ اللهُ وَيُصْـلِحُ بالَـكُم
duas.transliteration: Yahdīkumullāhu wa yuṣliḥu bālakum.
duas.meaning: May Allah guide you and set your affairs in order
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 189 · At-Tirmidhi 5/82, Ahmad 4/400, Abu Dawud 4/ 308. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 2/354.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: To the newlywed
duas.title: Chapter: To the newlywed
duas.arabic: بارَكَ اللّهُ لَك، وَبارَكَ عَلَـيْك، وَجَمَعَ بَيْـنَكُما في خَـيْر
duas.transliteration: Bārakallāhu lak, wa bāraka `alayk, wa jama`a baynakumā fī khayr.
duas.meaning: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and join you together in goodness.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 190 · Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah and At-Tirmidhi. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 1/316.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: On the wedding night or when buying an animal
duas.title: Chapter: On the wedding night or when buying an animal
duas.arabicTitle: دعاء المتزوج لنفسه ودعاء شراء الدابة
duas.arabic: إِذَا تَزَوَّجَ أَحَدُكُمُ امْرَأَةً، أَوْ إِذَا اشْتَرَى خَادِماً فَلْيَقُلْ: (اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ)، وَإِذَا اشْتَرَى بَعِيراً فَلْيَأْخُذْ بِذِرْوَةِ سَنَامِهِ وَلْيَقُلْ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ.
duas.transliteration: When any of you marries a woman or purchases a maid-servant then let him say:
duas.meaning: When any of you marries a woman or purchases a maid-servant then let him say : O Allah, I ask You for the goodness of her, and the goodness upon which You have created her, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of her, and from the evil upon which You have created her. If you purchase a camel then take hold of the top of its hump and say the same.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 191 · Abu Dawud 2/248 and Ibn Majah 1/617. See also Al-Albani, Sahih Ibn Majah 1/324.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Before sexual intercourse with the wife
duas.title: Chapter: Before sexual intercourse with the wife
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ الله اللّهُـمَّ جَنِّبْنا الشَّيْـطانَ، وَجَنِّبِ الشَّـيْطانَ ما رَزَقْـتَنا
duas.transliteration: Bismillāh. Allāhumma jannibnash-Shayṭān, wa jannibish-Shayṭāna mā razaqtanā.
duas.meaning: With the Name of Allah. O Allah, keep the Devil away from us, and keep the Devil away from that which You provide for us.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 192 · Al-Bukhari 6/141, Muslim 2/1028.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: When angry
duas.title: Chapter: When angry
duas.arabic: أَعـوذُ بِاللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْـطانِ الرَّجيـم
duas.transliteration: A`ūdhu billāhi minash-Shayṭānir-rajīm.
duas.meaning: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 193 · Al-Bukhari 7/99, Muslim 4/2015.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Upon seeing someone in trial or tribulation
duas.title: Chapter: Upon seeing someone in trial or tribulation
duas.arabic: الْحَمْـدُ للهِ الّذي عافاني مِمّا ابْتَـلاكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَـني عَلى كَثيـرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَـقَ تَفْضـيلا
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillāhi ‘l-ladhī `āfānī mimmab-talāka bihi wa faḍḍalanī `alā kathīrin mimman khalaqa tafḍīlā.
duas.meaning: Praise is to Allah Who has spared me what He has afflicted you with, and preferred me greatly above much of what He has created.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 194 · At-Tirmidhi 5/493,4. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/153.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: At a sitting or gathering
duas.title: Chapter: At a sitting or gathering
duas.arabic: عن ابن عمر قال : كان يعد لرسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في المجلس الواحد مائة مرة من قبل أن يقوم "رب اغفر لي وتب علي إنك أنت التواب الغفور"
duas.transliteration: Ibn Umar (ra) said:
duas.meaning: Ibn Umar (ra) said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to repeat in a single sitting: My Lord, forgive me, and accept my repentance, You are the Ever-Relenting, the All-Forgiving.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 195 · Sahih Ibn Majah 2/321. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/153.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: For the expiation of sins, said at the conclusion of a sitting or gathering
duas.title: Chapter: For the expiation of sins, said at the conclusion of a sitting or gathering
duas.arabic: سُبْحـانَكَ اللّهُـمَّ وَبِحَمدِك، أَشْهَـدُ أَنْ لا إِلهَ إِلاّ أَنْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتوبُ إِلَـيْك
duas.transliteration: Subhānaka Allāhumma wa biḥamdik, ash-hadu an lā ilāha illā ant, astaghfiruka wa atību ilayk.
duas.meaning: Glory is to You, O Allah, and praise is to You. I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship but You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 196 · Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah, At-Tirmidhi and An-Nasa'i. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/ 153. Aishah (RA) said: "Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not sit in a gathering, and did not recite the Qur'an, and did not perform any prayer without concluding by saying ... (then she quoted the above)." This was reported by An-Nasa'i in 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah (no.308), and Dr. Farooq Hamadah graded it authentic in his checking of the same book, p. 273. See also Ahmad 6/77

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Returning a supplication of forgiveness
duas.title: Chapter: Returning a supplication of forgiveness
duas.arabicTitle: الدعاء لمن قال غفر الله لك
duas.arabic: وَلَكَ
duas.transliteration: Walaka
duas.meaning: And you.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 197 · Ahmad 5/82, and An-Nasa'i in 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah p. 218, with checking by Dr. Farooq Hamadah.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: To one who does you a favour
duas.title: Chapter: To one who does you a favour
duas.arabic: جَزاكَ اللهُ خَـيْراً
duas.transliteration: Jazākallāhu khayra.
duas.meaning: May Allah reward you with good.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 198 · At-Tirmidhi (no. 2035). See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 2/200 and Sahihul-Jami' (no. 6244).

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Protection from the Dajjal
duas.title: Chapter: Protection from the Dajjal
duas.arabicTitle: الذكر الذي يعصم الله به من الدجال
duas.arabic: .(مَنْ حَفِظَ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ مِنْ أَوَّلِ سُورَةِ الْكَهْفِ عُصِمَ مِنَ الدَّجَّالِ) ، وَالْاسْتِعَاذَةُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ فِتْنَتِهِ عَقِبَ التَّشَهُّدِ الْأَخِيرِ مِنْ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ.
duas.meaning: Whoever memorizes ten 'Ayat (Verses) from the beginning of Surat Al-Kahf, will be protected from the False Messiah 1 if he recites in every prayer after the final Tashahhud before ending the prayer, seeking the protection of Allah from the trials of the False Messiah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 199 · 1 Muslim 1/555, another version mentions the last ten 'Ayat, Muslim 1/556. 2 See invocations no. 55 and 56 of this book.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: To one who pronounces his love for you, for Allah’s sake
duas.title: Chapter: To one who pronounces his love for you, for Allah’s sake
duas.arabicTitle: الدعاء لمن قال إني أحبك في الله
duas.arabic: أَحَبَّـكَ الّذي أَحْبَبْـتَني لَه
duas.transliteration: Aḥabbaka ‘lladhī aḥbabtanī lah.
duas.meaning: May He for Whose sake you love me, love you.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 200 · Abu Dawud 4/333. Al-Albani graded it good in Sahih Abu Dawud 3/965.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: To one who has offered you some of his wealth
duas.title: Chapter: To one who has offered you some of his wealth
duas.arabic: بارَكَ اللهُ لَكَ في أَهْلِكَ وَمالِك
duas.transliteration: Bārakallāhu laka fī ahlika wa mālik.
duas.meaning: May Allah bless you in your family and your property.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 201 · Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-BAri 4/88.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: To the debtor when his debt is settled
duas.title: Chapter: To the debtor when his debt is settled
duas.arabic: بارَكَ اللهُ لَكَ في أَهْلِكَ وَمالِك، إِنَّما جَـزاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ والأَداء
duas.transliteration: Bārakallāhu laka fī ahlika wa mālik, innamā jazā'us-salafi ‘l-ḥamdu wa‘l-adā'.
duas.meaning: May Allah bless you in your family and your wealth, surely the reward for a loan is praise and returning (what was borrowed).
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 202 · An-Nasa'i, 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylahp. 300, Ibn Majah 2/809. See also Al-Albani, Sahih Ibn Majah2/55.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: For fear of shirk
duas.title: Chapter: For fear of shirk
duas.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ إِنّـي أَعـوذُبِكَ أَنْ أُشْـرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنا أَعْـلَمْ، وَأَسْتَـغْفِرُكَ لِما لا أَعْـلَم
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a`ūdhu bika an ushrika bika wa anā a`lam, wa astaghfiruka limā lā a`lam.
duas.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I associate anything with You knowingly, and I seek Your forgiveness for what I know not.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 203 · Ahmad 4/403. See also Al-Albani, Sahihul-Jami' As-Saghir 3/233 and Sahihut-Targhib wat- Tarhib 1/19.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: To someone who says "May Allah bless you"
duas.title: Chapter: To someone who says "May Allah bless you"
duas.arabicTitle: الدعاء لمن قال بارك الله فيك
duas.arabic: وَفيكَ بارَكَ الله
duas.transliteration: Wafīka bārakallāh.
duas.meaning: And may Allah bless you.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 204 · Ibn As-Sunni, p. 138, (no. 278). See also Ibn Al-Qayyim, Al-Wdbil As-Sayyib, p. 304, with checking by Basheer Muhammad ?Uyoon.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: The scorn of ascribing things to evil omens
duas.title: Chapter: The scorn of ascribing things to evil omens
duas.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ لا طَيْـرَ إِلاّ طَيْـرُك، وَلا خَـيْرَ إِلاّ خَـيْرُك، وَلا إِلهَ غَيْـرُك
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma lā ṭayra illā ṭayruk, wa lā khayra illā khayruk, wa lā ilāha ghayruk.
duas.meaning: O Allah there is no portent other than Your portent, no goodness other than Your goodness, and none worthy of worship other than You.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 205 · Ahmad 2/220, Ibn As-Sunni (no. 292). See also Al-Albani, Silsilatul-'Ahadlth As-Sahihah 3/54, (no. 1065). As for bodings of good, these used to please the Prophet (ﷺ) and so when he heard good words from someone, he used to say: "We have taken from you a good portent from your mouth," Abu Dawud, Ahmad. See also Al-Albani, Silsilatul-'Ahadith As-Sahihah 2/363, and it is with Abu Ash-Shaikh Al-Asfahani in 'Akhlaqun-Nabiyy, pg. 270.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: When mounting an animal or any means of transport
duas.title: Chapter: When mounting an animal or any means of transport
duas.arabicTitle: دعاء ركوب الدابة أو ما يقوم مقامها
duas.arabic: بِسْـمِ اللهِ وَالْحَمْـدُ لله، ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ * وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ﴾ الحَمْـدُ لله، الحَمْـدُ لله، الحَمْـدُ لله، اللهُ أكْـبَر، اللهُ أكْـبَر، اللهُ أكْـبَر، سُـبْحانَكَ اللّهُـمَّ إِنّي ظَلَـمْتُ نَفْسي فَاغْـفِرْ لي، فَإِنَّهُ لا يَغْفِـرُ الذُّنوبَ إِلاّ أَنْـت
duas.transliteration: Bismillāh, walḥamdulillāh. Subḥāna ‘lladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wa mā kunnā lahu muqrinīn. Wa innā ilā Rabbinā lamunqalibūn. Alḥamdulillāh, alḥamdulillāh, alḥamdulillāh, Allāhu Akbar, Allāhu Akbar, Allāhu Akbar, Subḥānaka ‘llāhumma innī ẓalamtu nafsī, faghfir lī, fa innahu lā yaghfirudh-dhunūba illā ant.
duas.meaning: With the Name of Allah. Praise is to Allah. Glory is to Him Who has provided this for us though we could never have had it by our efforts. Surely, unto our Lord, we are returning. Praise is to Allah. Praise is to Allah. Praise is to Allah. Allah is the Most Great. Allah is the Most Great. Allah is the Most Great. Glory is to You. O Allah, I have wronged my own soul. Forgive me, for surely none forgives sins but You.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 206 · Abu Dawud 3/34, At-Tirmidhi 5/501. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi3/156.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: For travel
duas.title: Chapter: For travel
duas.arabic: "اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، ﴿سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ * وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ﴾ اللَّهُمَّ إِنّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا البِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَليفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ"، وإذا رَجَعَ قَالَهُنَّ وَزَادَ فِيهِنَّ: "آيِبُونَ، تائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ".
duas.transliteration: Allāhu Akbar, Allāhu Akbar, Allāhu Akbar, Subḥāna ‘l-ladhi sakhkhara lanā hādhā wa mā kunnā lahu muqrinīn. Wa innā ilā Rabbinā lamunqalibūn. Allāhumma innā nas'aluka fī safarinā hādha ‘l-birra wat-taqwā, Wa mina ‘l-`amali mā tarḍā, Allāhumma hawwin `alaynā safaranā hādhā waṭwi `annā bu`dah, Allāhumma antas-sāḥibu fis-safar, wa ‘l-khalīfatu fil-ahl, Allāhumma innī a`ūdhu bika min wa`thā'is-safar, wa ka'ābati ‘l-manẓar, wa sū'il-munqalabi fil-māli wa ‘l-ahl. (Upon returning recite the same again adding):
duas.meaning: Allah is the Most Great. Allah is the Most Great. Allah is the Most Great. Glory is to Him Who has provided this for us though we could never have had it by our efforts. Surely, unto our Lord we are returning. O Allah, we ask You on this our journey for goodness and piety, and for works that are pleasing to You. O Allah, lighten this journey for us and make its distance easy for us. O Allah, You are our Companion on the road and the One in Whose care we leave our family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from this journey's hardships, and from the wicked sights in store and from finding our family and property in misfortune upon returning. (Upon returning recite the same again adding :) We return repentant to our Lord, worshipping our Lord, and praising our Lord.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 207 · Muslim 2/978.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Upon entering a town or village
duas.title: Chapter: Upon entering a town or village
duas.arabic: أللّـهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّـمواتِ السّـبْعِ وَما أَظْلَلَـن، وَرَبَّ الأَراضيـنَ السّـبْعِ وَما أقْلَلْـن، وَرَبَّ الشَّيـاطينِ وَما أَضْلَلْـن، وَرَبَّ الرِّياحِ وَما ذَرَيْـن، أَسْـأَلُـكَ خَيْـرَ هذهِ الْقَـرْيَةِ وَخَيْـرَ أَهْلِـها، وَخَيْـرَ ما فيها، وَأَعـوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَـرِّها وَشَـرِّ أَهْلِـها، وَشَـرِّ ما فيها
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma Rabbas-samāwātis-sab`i wa mā aẓlaln, Wa Rabba ‘l-arāḍīnas-sab`i wa mā aqlaln, wa Rabbash-shayāṭīni wa mā aḍlaln, wa Rabbar-riyāḥi wa mā dharayn. As'aluka khayra hādhihi ‘l-qaryah, wa khayra ahlihā, wa khayra māfīhā, wa a`ūdhu bika min sharrihā, wa sharri ahlihā, wa sharri mā fīhā.
duas.meaning: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all they overshadow, Lord of the seven worlds and all they uphold, Lord of the devils and all they lead astray, Lord of the winds and all they scatter. I ask You for the goodness of this town, and for the goodness of its people, and for the goodness it contains. I seek refuge in You from its evil, from the evil of its people, and from the evil it contains.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 208 · Al-Hakim who graded it authentic and Ath-Tfaahabi agreed 2/100, and Ibn As-Sunni (no. 524). Al-Hafidh graded it good in his checking of Al-'Athkdr 5/154. Ibn Baz said in Tuhfatul-'Akhydr p. 37, that An-Nasa'i recorded it with a good chain of narration.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: When entering the market
duas.title: Chapter: When entering the market
duas.arabic: لا إلهَ إلاّ اللّه وحدَهُ لا شريكَ لهُ، لهُ المُلْـكُ ولهُ الحَمْـد، يُحْيـي وَيُميـتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لا يَمـوت، بِيَـدِهِ الْخَـيْرُ وَهوَ على كلّ شيءٍ قدير
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāh waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, Lahu ‘l-mulku wa lahu ‘l-ḥamd, Yuḥyī wa yumīt, wa huwa ḥayyun lā yamūt, Biyadihi ‘l-khayr, wa huwa `alā kulli shay'in Qadīr.
duas.meaning: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise. He brings life and He causes death, and He is living and does not die. In His Hand is all good, and He is Able to do all things.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 209 · At-Tirmidhi 5/291, and Al-Hakim 1/538. Al-Albani graded it good in Sahih Ibn Majah 2/21 and Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/152.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: When the mounted animal (or mean of transport) stumbles
duas.title: Chapter: When the mounted animal (or mean of transport) stumbles
duas.arabic: بِسْـمِ اللهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillāh.
duas.meaning: With the Name of Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 210 · Abu Dawud 4/296. Al-Albani graded it authentic in Sahih Abu Dawud 3/941.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Supplication of the traveller for the resident
duas.title: Chapter: Supplication of the traveller for the resident
duas.arabic: أَسْتَـوْدِعُكُـمُ اللَّهَ الَّذي لا تَضـيعُ وَدائِعُـه
duas.transliteration: Astawdi`ukumu ‘llāha ‘l-ladhi lā taḍī`u wadā'i`uh.
duas.meaning: I place you in the trust of Allah, whose trust is never misplaced.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 211 · Ahmad 2/403, Ibn Majah 2/943. See also Al-Albani, Sahih Ibn Majah 2/133.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Supplication of the resident for the traveller
duas.title: Chapter: Supplication of the resident for the traveller
duas.arabic: أَسْتَـوْدِعُ اللَّهَ ديـنَكَ وَأَمانَتَـكَ، وَخَـواتيـمَ عَمَـلِك
duas.transliteration: Astawdi`ullāha dīnak, wa amānatak, wa khawātīma `amalik.
duas.meaning: I leave your religion in the care of Allah, as well as your safety, and the last of your deeds.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 212 · Ahmad 2/7, At-Tirmidhi 5/499. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 2/155.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Supplication of the resident for the traveller
duas.title: Chapter: Supplication of the resident for the traveller
duas.arabic: زَوَّدَكَ اللَّهُ التقْوى، وَغَفَـرَذَنْـبَكَ، وَيَسَّـرَ لَكَ الخَـيْرَ حَيْـثُما كُنْـت
duas.transliteration: Zawwadaka ‘llāhut-taqwā, wa ghafara dhanbak, wa yassara laka ‘l-khayra ḥaythu mā kunt.
duas.meaning: May Allah give you piety as your provision, forgive your sins, and make goodness easy for you wherever you are.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 213 · At-Tirmidhi. See Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi, 3/155.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Takbir and Tasbih during travel
duas.title: Chapter: Takbir and Tasbih during travel
duas.arabic: قَالَ جَابِرٌ رضي الله عنه: (كُنَّا إِذَا صَعَدْنَا كَبَّرْنَا، وَإِذَا نَزَلْنَا سَبَّحْنَا)
duas.meaning: Jabir (ra), said:
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 214 · Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 6/135.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Prayer of the traveller as dawn approaches
duas.title: Chapter: Prayer of the traveller as dawn approaches
duas.arabic: سَمِـعَ سـامِعٌ بِحَمْـدِ اللهِ وَحُسْـنِ بَلائِـهِ عَلَيْـنا. رَبَّنـا صـاحِبْـنا وَأَفْـضِل عَلَيْـنا عائِذاً باللهِ مِنَ النّـار
duas.transliteration: Sami`a sāmi`un biḥamdillāhi wa ḥusni balā'ihi `alaynā. Rabbanā ṣāḥibnā, wa afḍil `alaynā, `ā'idhan billāhi minan-nār.
duas.meaning: He Who listens has heard that we praise Allah for the good things He gives us. Our Lord, be with us and bestow Your favor upon us. I seek the protection of Allah from the Fire.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 215 · Muslim 4/2086, the meaning of sami`a sāmi`un (who listens has heard) is that 'a witness has witnessed our praise of Allah due to His blessings and favor upon us.' It could also be read samma`a sāmi`un, in which case it means 'one who has heard this statement of mine will convey it to another and he will say it as well.' This is due to the attention given to the Thikr (remembrance of Allah) and supplications made during the early morning hours. The meaning of his saying 'Our Lord, be with us and bestow Your favor upon us' is: 'Our Lord, protect us and guard us. Bless us with Your numerous bounties, and avert from us every evil.' See An-Nawawi, Sharh Sahih Muslim 17/39.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Stopping or lodging somewhere in travel and otherwise
duas.title: Chapter: Stopping or lodging somewhere in travel and otherwise
duas.arabicTitle: الدعاء إذا نزل منزلا في سفر أو غيره
duas.arabic: أَعـوذُ بِكَلِـماتِ اللّهِ التّـامّاتِ مِنْ شَـرِّ ما خَلَـق
duas.transliteration: A`ūdhu bikalimāti ‘llāhit-tāmmāti min sharri mā khalaq.
duas.meaning: I seek refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 216 · Muslim 4/2080.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: While returning from travel
duas.title: Chapter: While returning from travel
duas.arabic: يُكَبِّرُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَرَفٍ ثَلاَثَ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنا حَامِدُونَ، صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزابَ وَحْدَهُ
duas.transliteration: From every elevated point say Allāhu Akbar (three times), and then recite:
duas.meaning: From every elevated point say Allāhu Akbar (Allah is the Most Great) three times and then recite: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is Able to do all things. We return repentant to our Lord, worshipping our Lord, and praising our Lord. He fulfilled His Promise, He aided His slave, and He alone defeated the Confederates.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 217 · Bukhari 7/163, Muslim 2/980. The Prophet (ﷺ) used to say this when returning from a campaign or from Hajj.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: What to say upon receiving pleasing or displeasing news
duas.title: Chapter: What to say upon receiving pleasing or displeasing news
duas.arabicTitle: ما يقول من أتاه أمر يسره أو يكرهه
duas.arabic: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَتَاهُ الْأَمْرُ يَسُرُّهُ قَالَ: (الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ) وَإِذَا أَتَاهُ الْأَمْرُ يَكْرَهُهُ قَالَ: (الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ)
duas.transliteration: When something happened that pleased him, the Prophet (ﷺ) used to say:
duas.meaning: When something happened that pleased him, the Prophet (ﷺ) used to say: Praise is to Allah Who by His blessings all good things are perfected. And if something happened that displeased him, he used to say: Praise is to Allah in all circumstances.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 218 · Ibn As-Sunni, 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah, and Al-Hakim who graded it authentic 1/499. See also Al-Albani, Sahihul-Jami' As-Saghir 4/201.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (saws)
duas.title: Chapter: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (saws)
duas.arabic: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيَّ صَلاَةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ بِهَا عَشْراً)
duas.meaning: The Prophet (ﷺ) said:
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 219 · Muslim 1/288.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (saws)
duas.title: Chapter: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (saws)
duas.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (لاَ تَجْعَلُوا قَبْرِي عِيداً وَصَلُّوا عَلَيَّ؛ فَإِنَّ صَلاَتَكُم تَبْلُغُنِي حَيْثُ كُنْتُمْ)
duas.meaning: The Prophet (ﷺ) said:
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 220 · Abu Dawud 2/218, Ahmad 2/367. Al-Albani graded it authentic in Sahih Abu Dawud 2/383.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (saws)
duas.title: Chapter: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (saws)
duas.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (الْبَخِيلُ مَنْ ذُكِرْتُ عِنْدَهُ فَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيَّ)
duas.meaning: The Prophet (ﷺ) said:
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 221 · At-Tirmidhi 5/551 and others. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/177 and Sahihul-Jarai' As-Saghir 3/25.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (saws)
duas.title: Chapter: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (saws)
duas.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم:(إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَلاَئِكَةً سَيَّاحِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ يُبَلِّغُونِي مِنْ أُمَّتِي السَّلاَمَ)
duas.meaning: The Prophet (ﷺ) said:
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 222 · An-Nasa'i, Al-Hakim 2/421. Al-Albani graded it authentic in Sahih An-Nasa'i 1/274.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (saws)
duas.title: Chapter: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (saws)
duas.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (مَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ يُسَلِّمُ عَلَيَّ إِلاَّ رَدَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيَّ رُوحِيَ حَتَّى أَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمَ)
duas.meaning: The Prophet (ﷺ) said:
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 223 · Abu Dawud (no. 2041). Al-Albani graded it good in Sahih Abu Dawud 1/383.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Excellence of spreading the Islamic greeting
duas.title: Chapter: Excellence of spreading the Islamic greeting
duas.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (لاَ تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ حَتَّى تُؤْمِنُوا، وَلاَ تُؤْمِنُوا حَتَّى تَحَابُّوا، أَوَلاَ أَدُلُّكُم عَلَى شَيْءٍ إِذَا فَعَلْتُمُوهُ تَحَابَبْتُم، أَفْشُوا السَّلاَمَ بَيْنَكُمْ)
duas.meaning: The Prophet (ﷺ) said:
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 224 · Muslim 1/74 and others.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Excellence of spreading the Islamic greeting
duas.title: Chapter: Excellence of spreading the Islamic greeting
duas.arabic: ثَلاَثٌ مَنْ جَمَعَهُنَّ فَقَدْ جَمَعَ الْإِيمَانَ: الْإِنْصَافُ مِنْ نَفْسِكَ، وَبَذْلُ السَّلاَمِ لِلْعَالَمِ، وَالْإِنْفَاقُ مِنَ الإِقْتَارِ
duas.meaning: Three characteristics, whoever combines them, has completed his faith:
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 225 · Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 1/82 as a statement of the Companion 'Ammar (RA).

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Excellence of spreading the Islamic greeting
duas.title: Chapter: Excellence of spreading the Islamic greeting
duas.arabic: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: أنَّ رَجُلاً سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أيُّ الْإِسْلاَمِ خَيْرٌ قَالَ: (تُطْعِمُ الطَّعَامَ، وَتَقْرأُ السَّلاَمَ عَلَى مَنْ عَرَفْتَ وَمَنْ لَمْ تَعْرِفْ)
duas.meaning: `Abdullah bin `Umar (RA) said:
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 226 · Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 1/55, Muslim 1/65.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Returning a greeting to a disbeliever
duas.title: Chapter: Returning a greeting to a disbeliever
duas.arabicTitle: كيف يرد السلام على الكافر إذا سلم
duas.arabic: إذَا سَلَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ فَقُولُوا: وَعَلَيْكُمْ
duas.transliteration: If one of the People of the Scripture (i.e. Christians and Jews) greets you, saying As-Salāmu `alaykum, then say (to him):
duas.meaning: If one of the People of the Scripture (i.e. Christians and Jews) greets you saying As-Salaamu `alaykum, then say (to him): And upon you .
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 227 · Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 11/42, Muslim 4/1705.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Upon hearing a rooster crow or the braying of a donkey
duas.title: Chapter: Upon hearing a rooster crow or the braying of a donkey
duas.arabicTitle: دعاء عند سماع صياح الديك ونهيق الحمار
duas.arabic: إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ صِيَاحَ الدِّيَكَةِ فَاسْأَلُوا اللَّهَ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ؛ فَإِنَّهَا رَأَتْ مَلَكاً وَإِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نَهِيقَ الْحِمَارِ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ؛ فَإِنَّهُ رَأَى شَيْطَاناً
duas.meaning: When you hear the cock's crow, ask Allah for His favor upon you for surely it has seen an angel. When you hear the bray of a donkey, seek refuge in Allah from Satan, for surely it has seen a devil.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 228 · Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 6/350, Muslim 4/2092.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Upon hearing the barking of dogs at night
duas.title: Chapter: Upon hearing the barking of dogs at night
duas.arabicTitle: دعاء عند سماع نباح الكلاب بالليل
duas.arabic: إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نُبَاحَ الْكِلاَبِ وَنَهِيقَ الْحَمِيرِ بِاللَّيْلِ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنْهُنَّ؛ فَإِنَّهُنَّ يَرَيْنَ مَا لاَ تَرَوْنَ
duas.meaning: When you hear a dog barking or a donkey braying in the night, then seek refuge in Allah from them, for surely they have seen what you see not.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 229 · Abu Dawud 4/327, Ahmad 3/306. Al-Albani graded it authentic in Sahih Abu Dawud 3/961.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: For one you have insulted
duas.title: Chapter: For one you have insulted
duas.arabic: قال صلى الله عليه وسلم: "اللَّهُم فأيما مؤمن سببته فاجعل ذلك له قربة إليك يوم القيامة"
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma fa'ayyumā mu'minin sababtuhu faj`al dhālika lahu qurbatan ilayka yawma ‘l-qiyāmah.
duas.meaning: O Allah, whomever of the believers I have abused, give him the reward of a sacrificial slaughter for it on the Day of Resurrection.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 230 · Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 11/171, Muslim 4/2007. The wording in Muslim's report is: 'make it a purification for him and a source of mercy.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: The etiquette of praising a fellow Muslim
duas.title: Chapter: The etiquette of praising a fellow Muslim
duas.arabicTitle: ما يقول المسلم إذا مدح المسلم
duas.arabic: قال صلى الله عليه وسلم: "إِذَا كَانَ أَحَدُكُم مَادِحاً صَاحِبَهُ لاَ مَحَالَةَ فَلْيَقُلْ: أَحْسِبُ فُلاَناً وَاللَّهُ حَسِيبُهُ، وَلاَ أُزَكِّي عَلَى اللَّهِ أَحَداً، أَحْسِبُهُ – إِنْ كَانَ يَعْلَمُ ذَاكَ – كَذَا وَكَذَا"
duas.transliteration: If any of you praises his companion then let him say:
duas.meaning: If any of you praises his companion then let him say: I consider (such and such a person), and Allah is his Assessor, (meaning: and I cannot claim anyone to be pious before Allah) if you know of this (good character trait in the person) to be such and such (saying what he thinks is praiseworthy in that person).
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 231 · Muslim 4/2296.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: For the one that have been praised
duas.title: Chapter: For the one that have been praised
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ [وَاجْعَلْنِي خَيْرًا مِمَّا يَظُّنُّونَ]
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma lā tu'ākhidhnī bimā yaqūlūn, waghfir lī mā lā ya`lamūn [waj`alnī khayran mimmā yaẓunnūn].
duas.meaning: O Allah, do not call me to account for what they say and forgive me for what they have no knowledge of [and make me better than they imagine].
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 232 · Al-Bukhari, Al-'Adabul-Mufrad no. 761. See Al-Albani, Sahih Al-'Adabul-Mufrad (no. 585). The portion between brackets if from Al-Bayhaqi, Shu'ab Al-Iman 4/228, and comes another account.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: The Talbiya for the one doing Hajj or 'Umrah
duas.title: Chapter: The Talbiya for the one doing Hajj or 'Umrah
duas.arabicTitle: كيف يلبي المحرم في الحج أو العمرة
duas.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ والنِّعْمَة لَكَ والمُلْكُ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
duas.transliteration: Labbayk-Allāhumma labbayk, labbayka lā sharīka laka labbayk, inna ‘l-ḥamda, wanni`mata, laka wa ‘l-mulk, lā sharīka lak.
duas.meaning: I am here at Your service, O Allah, I am here at Your service. I am here at Your service, You have no partner, I am here at Your service. Surely the praise, and blessings are Yours, and the dominion. You have no partner.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 233 · Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 3/408, Muslim 2/841.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: The Takbîr passing the black stone
duas.title: Chapter: The Takbîr passing the black stone
duas.arabic: طَافَ النَّبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْبَيْتِ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ كُلَّمَا أَتَى الرُّكْنَ أَشَارَ إِلَيْهِ بِشَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ وَكَبَّرَ
duas.meaning: The Prophet (ﷺ) performed Tawaf riding a camel. Every time he passed the corner (containing the Black Stone), he would point to it with something that he was holding and say:
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 234 · Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 3/476. See also 472. The 'something' that was referred to in this Hadith was a cane.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Between the Yemeni corner and the black stone
duas.title: Chapter: Between the Yemeni corner and the black stone
duas.arabicTitle: الدعاء بين الركن اليماني والحجر الأسود
duas.arabic: ﴿رَبَّنَا آتِنَا في الدُّنْيَا حسَنَةً وفي الآخِرَةِ حسَنةً وقِنَا عذَابَ النَّارِ﴾
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā ātinā fid-dunyā ḥasanah wa fi ‘l-ākhirati ḥasanah wa qinā `adhāban-nār.
duas.meaning: Our Lord, grant us the good things in this world, and the good things in the next life, and save us from the punishment of the Fire.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 235 · Abu Dawud 2/179, Ahmad 3/411, Al-Baghawi, Sharhus-Sunnah 7/128. Al-Albani graded it good in Sahih Abu Dawud 1/354. The Ayat is from Surat Al-Baqarah, 2:201.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: When at Mount Safa and Mount Marwah
duas.title: Chapter: When at Mount Safa and Mount Marwah
duas.arabic: (لَمَّا دَنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الصَّفَا قَرَأَ: ﴿إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَآئِرِ اللَّهِ﴾ "أَبْدَأُ بِمَا بَدَأَ اللَّهُ بِهِ" فَبَدَأَ بِالصَّفَا فَرَقِيَ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى رَأَى الْبَيْتَ، فَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ، فَوَحَّدَ اللَّهَ وَكبَّرَهُ وَقَالَ: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ، ثُمَّ دَعَا بَيْنَ ذلكَ. قَالَ مِثْلَ هَذَا ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ) الْحَدِيثُ. وَفِيهِ: (فَفَعَلَ عَلَى الْمَرْوَةِ كَمَا فَعَلَ عَلَى الصَّفَا)
duas.transliteration: Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) approached Mount Safa, he would recite:
duas.meaning: Whenever the Prophet (ﷺ) approached Mount Safa, he would recite: Surely Safa and Marwah are among the signs of Allah. I begin by that which Allah began. He began (his Sa'y) at Mount Safa climbing it until he could see the House. He then faced the Qiblah repeating the words: There is none worthy of worship but Allah, and Allah is the Most Great. Then he said: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner, His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is Able to do all things. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, He fulfilled His Promise, He aided His slave, and He alone defeated Confederates. Then he would ask Allah for what he liked, repeating the same thing like this three times. He did at Mount Marwah as he did at Mount Safa.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 236 · Muslim 2/888.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: The Day of 'Arafah
duas.title: Chapter: The Day of 'Arafah
duas.arabic: خير الدعاء دعاء يوم عرفة ، وخيرُ ما قلت أنا والنبيُّون من قبلي : لا إله إلا الله وحدهُ لا شريك لهُ ، لهُ الملكُ ولهُ الحمدُ وهو على كل شيء قدير.
duas.transliteration: Lā 'ilāha 'illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu wa huwa `alā kulli shay'in qadīr.
duas.meaning: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah Alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is Able to do all things.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 237 · At-Tirmidhi. Al-Albani graded it good in Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/184, and also Silsilatul-'Ahadith As-Sahihah 4/6.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Remembrance at Muzdalifa
duas.title: Chapter: Remembrance at Muzdalifa
duas.arabic: رَكِبَ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْقَصْوَاءَ حَتَّى أَتَى الْمَشْعَرَ الْحَرَامَ فَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ (فَدَعَاهُ، وَكَبَّرَهُ، وَهَللَّهُ، وَوَحَّدَهُ) فَلَمْ يَزَلْ وَاقِفاً حَتَّى أَسْفَرَ جِدَّاً فَدَفَعَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَطْلُعَ الشَّمسُ.
duas.meaning: 'He (ﷺ) rode Al-Qaswa until he reached Al-MashAAar Al-Haram, he then faced the qiblah, supplicated to Allah, and extoled His greatness and oneness. He stood until the sun shone but left before it rose.'
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 238 · Muslim 2/891.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Takbir when throwing each pebble at the Jamarat
duas.title: Chapter: Takbir when throwing each pebble at the Jamarat
duas.arabicTitle: التكبير عند رمي الجمار مع كل حصاة
duas.arabic: يُكَبِّرُ كُلَّمَا رَمَى بِحَصَاةٍ عِنْدَ الْجِمَارِ الثَّلاَثِ، ثُمَّ يَتَقَدَّمُ، ويَقِفُ يَدْعُو مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبلَةِ، رَافِعاً يَدَيْهِ بَعْدَ الْجَمْرَةِ الْأُولَى وَالثَّانِيَةِ. أَمَّا جَمْرَةُ الْعَقَبَةِ فَيَرْمِيهَا وَيُكَبِّرُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ حَصَاةٍ وَيَنْصَرِفُ وَلاَ يَقِفُ عِنْدَهَا
duas.meaning: The Prophet (ﷺ) said Allāhu Akbar (Allah is the Most Great) with each pebble he threw at the three pillars. Then he went forward, stood facing the Qiblah, and raised his hands and called upon Allah. That was after (stoning) the first and second pillars. As for the third, he stoned it and called out Allāhu Akbar with every pebble he threw, but when he was finished he left without standing at it (for supplications).
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 239 · Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 3/581, 3, 4, and Muslim

duas.categoryName: Chapter: At times of amazement and that which delights
duas.title: Chapter: At times of amazement and that which delights
duas.arabicTitle: ما يقول عند التعجب والأمر السار
duas.arabic: سُـبْحانَ الله
duas.transliteration: Subḥānallāh!
duas.meaning: (Glory is to Allah).
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 240 · Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 1/210, 390, 414 and Muslim 4/1857.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: At times of amazement and that which delights
duas.title: Chapter: At times of amazement and that which delights
duas.arabicTitle: ما يقول عند التعجب والأمر السار
duas.arabic: اللهُ أَكْـبَر
duas.transliteration: Allāhu Akbar!
duas.meaning: (Allah is the Most Great)
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 241 · Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 8/441. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 2/103, 235, Ahmad 5/218.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Upon receiving pleasant news
duas.title: Chapter: Upon receiving pleasant news
duas.arabicTitle: ما يفعل من أتاه أمر يسره
duas.arabic: كَانَ النَّبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَتَاهُ أَمْرٌ يَسُرُّهُ أَوْ يُسَرُّ بِهِ خَرَّ سَاجِداً شُكْراً لِلَّهِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى
duas.meaning: The Prophet (ﷺ), upon receiving news which pleased him or which caused pleasure, would prostrate in gratitude to Allah blessed and exalted.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 242 · Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah, At-Tirmidhi. See also Al-Albani, Sahih Ibn Majah 1/233, and 'Irwa'ul-Ghalil 2/226.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: When feeling some pain in the body
duas.title: Chapter: When feeling some pain in the body
duas.arabicTitle: ما يفعل ويقول من أحس وجعاً في جسده
duas.arabic: ضَعْ يَدَكَ عَلَى الَّذِي تَألَّمَ مِنْ جَسَدِكَ وَقُلْ: "بِسْمِ اللَّهِ" ثَلاَثاً، وَقُلْ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ: "أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ"
duas.transliteration: Put your hand on the place where you feel pain and say:
duas.meaning: Put your hand on the place where you feel pain and say: With the Name of Allah (three times). Then say seven times: I seek refuge in Allah and in His Power from the evil of what I find and of what I guard against.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 243 · Muslim 4/1728.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: When in fear of afflicting something with an (evil) eye from oneself
duas.title: Chapter: When in fear of afflicting something with an (evil) eye from oneself
duas.arabicTitle: ما يقول من خشي أن يصيب شيئاً بعينه
duas.arabic: إِذَا رَأَى أَحَدُكُم مِنْ أَخِيهِ، أَوْ مِنْ نَفْسِهِ، أَوْ مِنْ مَالِهِ مَا يُعْجِبُهُ [فَلْيَدْعُ لَهُ بِالْبَرَكَةِ] فَإِنَّ الْعَيْنَ حَقٌّ
duas.meaning: If you see something from your brother, yourself or wealth which you find impressing, then invoke blessings for it, for the evil eye is indeed true.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 244 · Ahmad 4/447, Ibn Majah, Malik. Al-Albani graded it authentic in Sahihul-Jami' As-Saghir 1/212. Also see Al-Arna'ut's checking of Ibn Al-Qayyim's Zadul-Ma'ad 4/170.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: When startled
duas.title: Chapter: When startled
duas.arabic: لا إلهَ إلاّ اللّهُ
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāh!
duas.meaning: There is none worthy of worship but Allah!
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 245 · Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 6/181, Muslim 4/2208.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: When slaughtering or offering a sacrifice
duas.title: Chapter: When slaughtering or offering a sacrifice
duas.arabicTitle: ما يقول عند الذبح أو النحر
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ [اللَّهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَلَكَ] اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي
duas.transliteration: Bismillāh wallāhu Akbar [Allāhumma minka wa lak] Allāhumma taqabbal minnī.
duas.meaning: With the Name of Allah, Allah is the Most Great! [O Allah, from You and to You.] O Allah, accept it from me.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 246 · Muslim 3/ 1557, Al-Bayhaqi 9/287.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: To ward off the plot of the rebellious devils
duas.title: Chapter: To ward off the plot of the rebellious devils
duas.arabicTitle: ما يقول لرد كيد مردة الشياطين
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بكَلِمَاتِ اللهِ التَّامَّاتِ الَّتِي لَا يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ ولَا فَاجرٌ مِنْ شّرِّ مَا خَلقَ، وبَرَأَ وذَرَأَ، ومِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وِمنْ شَرِّ مَا يَعْرُجُ فيهَا، ومِن شَرِّ مَا ذَرَأَ في الأَرْضِ ومِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا، وِمنْ شَرِّ فِتَنِ اللَّيْلِ والنَّهارِ، ومِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ طارِقٍ إِلَّا طَارِقاً يَطْرُقُ بخَيْرٍ يَا رَحْمَنُ
duas.transliteration: A`ūdhu bikalimāti ‘llāhit-tāmmāti ‘llatī lā yujāwizuhunna barrun wa lā fājirun min sharri mā khalaq, wa bara'a wa dhara', wa min sharri mā yanzilu minas-samā', wa min sharri mā ya`ruju fīhā, wa min sharri mā dhara'a fi ‘l-arḍ, wa min sharri ma yakhruju minhā, wa min sharri fitani ‘llayli wannahār, wa min sharri kulli ṭāriqin illā ṭāriqan yaṭruqu bikhayr yā Rahmān.
duas.meaning: I seek refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah -which neither the upright nor the corrupt may overcome - from the evil of what He created, of what He made, and of what He scattered, from the evil of what descends from the heavens, and of what rises up to them, from the evil of what He scattered in the earth, and of what emerges from it, from the evil trials of night and day, and from the evil of every night visitor, except the night visitor who comes with good. O Merciful One.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 247 · Ahmad 3/419, with an authentic chain of narration, and Ibn As-Sunni (no. 637). Al-Arna'ut, graded its chain authentic in his checking of Al-'Aqidah At-Tahawiyyah p. 133. See also Majma'uz-Zawa'id, 10/127.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Seeking forgiveness and repentance
duas.title: Chapter: Seeking forgiveness and repentance
duas.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: "وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَسْتَغفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ فِي الْيَوْمِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةٍ"
duas.meaning: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 248 · Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 11/101.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Seeking forgiveness and repentance
duas.title: Chapter: Seeking forgiveness and repentance
duas.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: (يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ تُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ فَإِنِّي أَتُوبُ فِي الْيَوْمِ إِلَيْهِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ)
duas.meaning: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 249 · Muslim 4/2076.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Seeking forgiveness and repentance
duas.title: Chapter: Seeking forgiveness and repentance
duas.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: مَنْ قَالَ (أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظيمَ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ القَيّوُمُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيهِ)، غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ وَإِنْ كَانَ فَرَّ مِنَ الزَّحْفِ.
duas.transliteration: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:
duas.meaning: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Whoever says: I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Mighty, Whom there is none worthy of worship except Him, the Living, the Eternal, and I repent to Him, Allah will forgive him even if he has deserted the army's ranks.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 250 · Abu Dawud 2/85, At-Tirmidhi 5/569, and Al-Hakim who declared it authentic and Ath-Thahabi agreed with him 1/511. Al-Albani graded it authentic in Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/182. See also Jami'ul-'Usool li-'Ahdaith Ar-Rasool 4/ 389-90 checked by Al-Arna'ut.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Seeking forgiveness and repentance
duas.title: Chapter: Seeking forgiveness and repentance
duas.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ الرَّبُّ مِنَ الْعَبْدِ فِي جَوْفِ اللَّيْلِ الآخِرِ فَإِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ تَكُونَ مِمَّنْ يَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ فِي تِلْكَ السَّاعَةِ فَكُنْ
duas.meaning: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 251 · At-Tirmidhi, An-Nasa'i 1/279 and Al-Hakim. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/183, and Jdmi'ul-'Usool with Al-Arna'ut's checking 4/144.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Seeking forgiveness and repentance
duas.title: Chapter: Seeking forgiveness and repentance
duas.arabic: .وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ الْعَبْدُ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَهُوَ سَاجِدٌ فَأَكثِرُوا الدُّعَاءَ.
duas.meaning: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 252 · Muslim 1/350.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Seeking forgiveness and repentance
duas.title: Chapter: Seeking forgiveness and repentance
duas.arabic: .وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: إِنَّهُ لَيُغَانُ عَلَى قَلْبِي وَإِنِّي لأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ فِي الْيَوْمِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ.
duas.meaning: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 253 · Muslim 4/2075. Ibn 'Athir explains that the Prophet (ﷺ) was always vigilant in his remembrance and drawing near to Allah, and if he forgot to do any of what he normally did from time to time, or it slipped his mind, he felt as if he had wronged himself and so he would begin to seek the forgiveness of Allah. See Jami'ul-'Usool 4/386.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.title: Chapter: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.arabicTitle: من فضل التسبيح والتحميد ، والتهليل ، والتكبير
duas.arabic: قَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: مَنْ قَالَ (سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ) فِي يَوْمٍ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ حُطَّتْ خَطَايَاهُ وَلَوْ كَانَتْ مِثْلَ زَبَدِ الْبَحْر.
duas.transliteration: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:
duas.meaning: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Whoever says: Glorified is Allah and praised is He. one hundred times a day, will have his sins forgiven even if they are like the foam of the sea.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 254 · Al-Bukhari 7/168, Muslim 4/2071, see also invocation no. 91 of this book.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.title: Chapter: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.arabicTitle: من فضل التسبيح والتحميد ، والتهليل ، والتكبير
duas.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: مَنْ قَالَ (لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ) عَشْرَ مِرَارٍ، كَانَ كَمَنْ أَعْتَقَ أَرْبَعَةَ أَنْفُسٍ مِنْ وَلَدِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ
duas.transliteration: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:
duas.meaning: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Whoever says: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is Able to do all things. ten times, will have the reward for freeing four slaves from the Children of Isma'il.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 255 · Al-Bukhari 7/67, Muslim 4/2071, see also invocation no. 93 of this book.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.title: Chapter: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.arabicTitle: من فضل التسبيح والتحميد ، والتهليل ، والتكبير
duas.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ، ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ، حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ: (سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ)، (سُبْحانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ)
duas.transliteration: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:
duas.meaning: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Two words are light on the tongue, weigh heavily in the balance, and are loved by the Most Merciful One: Glorified is Allah and praised is He, Glorified is Allah the Most Great.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 256 · Al-Bukhari 7/168, Muslim 4/2072.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.title: Chapter: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.arabicTitle: من فضل التسبيح والتحميد ، والتهليل ، والتكبير
duas.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: لَأَنْ أَقُولَ (سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ)، أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا طَلَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمسُ.
duas.transliteration: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:
duas.meaning: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: For me to say: Glory is to Allah, and praise is to Allah, and there is none worthy of worship but Allah, and Allah is the Most Great. is dearer to me than all that the sun rises upon (i.e. the whole world).
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 257 · Muslim 4/2072.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.title: Chapter: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.arabicTitle: من فضل التسبيح والتحميد ، والتهليل ، والتكبير
duas.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: أَيَعْجِزُ أَحَدُكُم أَنْ يَكْسِبَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ حَسَنَةٍ؟ فَسَأَلَهُ سَائِلٌ مِنْ جُلَسَائِهِ كَيْفَ يَكْسِبُ أَحَدُنَا أَلْفَ حَسَنَةٍ؟ قَالَ: يُسَبِّحُ مِائَةَ تَسْبِيحَةٍ، فَيُكتَبُ لَهُ أَلْفُ حَسَنَةٍ أَوْ يُحَطُّ عَنْهُ أَلْفُ خَطِيئَةٍ.
duas.meaning: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 258 · Muslim 4/2073.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.title: Chapter: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.arabicTitle: من فضل التسبيح والتحميد ، والتهليل ، والتكبير
duas.arabic: مَنْ قَالَ (سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ) غُرِسَتْ لَهُ نَخْلَةٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ
duas.transliteration: Whoever says:
duas.meaning: Whoever says: Glorified is Allah the Most Great and praised is He. will have a date palm planted for him in Paradise.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 259 · At-Tirmidhi 5/511, and Al-Hakim who graded it authentic and Ath-Thahabi agreed 1/501. See also Al-Albani, Sahihul-Jami' As-Saghir 5/531 and Sahih At-Tirmidhi3/160.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.title: Chapter: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.arabicTitle: من فضل التسبيح والتحميد ، والتهليل ، والتكبير
duas.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ قَيْسٍ أَلاَ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَى كَنْزٍ مِنْ كُنُوزِ الْجَنَّةِ؟ فَقُلْتُ: بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: قُلْ (لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ).
duas.transliteration: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:
duas.meaning: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: "O Abdullah bin Qais, should I not point you to one of the treasures of Paradise?" I said, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah." So he told me to say: There is no power and no might except by Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 260 · Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 11/213, Muslim 4/2076.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.title: Chapter: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.arabicTitle: من فضل التسبيح والتحميد ، والتهليل ، والتكبير
duas.arabic: وَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: أَحَبُّ الْكَلاَمِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَرْبَعٌ: (سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ)، وَ(الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ)، وَ(لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ)، وَ(اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ)، لاَ يَضُرُّكَ بِأَيِّهِنَّ بَدَأتَ
duas.transliteration: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:
duas.meaning: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The most beloved words to Allah are four: Glorified is Allah, and The praise is for Allah, and There is none worthy of worship but Allah, and Allah is the Most Great.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 261 · Muslim 3/1685.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.title: Chapter: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.arabicTitle: من فضل التسبيح والتحميد ، والتهليل ، والتكبير
duas.arabic: جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ: عَلِّمْنِي كَلاماً أَقُولُهُ: قَالَ: قُلْ (لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيراً، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيراً، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ، لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ). قَالَ: فَهَؤُلاَءِ لِرَبِّي، فَمَا لِي؟ قَالَ: قُلْ (اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي).
duas.transliteration: A desert Arab came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "Teach me a word that I can say. " The Prophet told him to say:
duas.meaning: A desert Arab came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said, "Teach me a word that I can say. " The Prophet told him to say: There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Who has no partner, Allah is the Great, the Most Great, and praise is to Allah in abundance, glory is to Allah, Lord of the worlds. There is no power and no might but by Allah the Mighty, the Wise. He said, "That is for my Lord, but what about me?" The Prophet (ﷺ) told him to say: O Allah forgive me, and have mercy on me and guide me, and provide for me.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 262 · Muslim 4/2072, Abu Dawud reports the same Hadith with the addition: and when the Arab left, the Prophet (ﷺ) said: "He has filled his hands with goodness." 1/220.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.title: Chapter: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.arabicTitle: من فضل التسبيح والتحميد ، والتهليل ، والتكبير
duas.arabic: كَانَ الرَّجُلُ إِذَا أَسْلَمَ عَلَّمَهُ النَّبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصَّلاَةَ ثُمَّ أَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَدْعُوَ بِهَؤُلاَءِ الْكَلِمَاتِ: (اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرِ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَعَافِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي)
duas.transliteration: Whenever anyone accepted Islam, the Prophet (ﷺ) used to teach him how to pray then he would instruct him to invoke Allah with the following words:
duas.meaning: Whenever anyone accepted Islam, the Prophet (ﷺ) used to teach him how to pray then he would instruct him to invoke Allah with the following words: O Allah forgive me, and have mercy on me and guide me and give me good health and provide for me.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 263 · Muslim 4/2073, and in one of Muslim's reports there is the addition: 'For these words combine [the goodness of] this world and the next.'

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.title: Chapter: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.arabicTitle: من فضل التسبيح والتحميد ، والتهليل ، والتكبير
duas.arabic: إِنَّ أَفْضَلَ الدُّعَاءِ (الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ)، وَأَفْضَلَ الذِّكْرِ (لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ)
duas.transliteration: The most excellent invocation is:
duas.meaning: The most excellent invocation is: Praise is for Allah. and the most excellent words of remembrance are: There is none worthy of worship but Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 264 · At-Tirmidhi 5/462, Ibn Majah 2/1249, and Al-Hakim who graded it authentic and Ath-Tbahabi agreed 1/503. See Al-Albani, Sahihul-Jami' As-Saghir 1/362.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.title: Chapter: Excellence of Tasbih, Tahmid, Tahlil, and Takbir
duas.arabicTitle: من فضل التسبيح والتحميد ، والتهليل ، والتكبير
duas.arabic: الباقيات الصالحات : (سبحان الله) و(الحمد لله )، و(لا إله إلا الله)، و(الله أكبر) ،و (لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله).
duas.transliteration: The good deeds which endure are:
duas.meaning: The good deeds which endure are: Glorified is Allah, and The praise is for Allah, and There is none worthy of worship but Allah, and Allah is the Most Great, and There is no power and no might except by Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 265 · Ahmad (no. 513) (Ahmad Shakir, ed.) and its chain of narration is authentic. See Majma'uz-Zawa'id 1/297. Ibn Hajar mentions it in Bulughul-Maram saying that Ibn Hibban and Al-Hakim considered it authentic.

duas.categoryName: Chapter: How the Prophet ﷺ made tasbeeh
duas.title: Chapter: How the Prophet ﷺ made tasbeeh
duas.arabic: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو رضي الله عنهما قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ النَّبيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعْقِدُ التَّسْبِيحَ بِيَمِينِهِ.
duas.meaning: Abdullah bin 'Amr (RA) said:
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 266 · Abu Dawud with a different wording 2/81, and At-Tirmidhi 5/521. See also Al-Albani, Sahihul-Jami'As-Saghir 4/271 (no. 4865).

duas.categoryName: Chapter: Comprehensive types of good and manners
duas.title: Chapter: Comprehensive types of good and manners
duas.arabic: إِذَا كَانَ جُنْحُ اللَّيْلِ – أَوْ أَمْسَيْتُم – فَـكُفُّوا صِبْيانَـكُم، فَإِنَّ الشَّيَاطِينَ تَنْتَشِرُ حِينَئِذٍ، فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ سَاعَةٌ مِنَ اللَّيلِ فَخَلُّوهُمْ، وَأَغْلِقُوا الأَبْوَابَ وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ؛ فَإِنَّ الشَّيطَانَ لاَ يَفْتَحُ بَاباً مُغلَقاً، وَأَوْكُوا قِرَبَكُمْ، وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ، وَخَمِّرُوا آنِيَتَكُم، وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ، وَلَوْ أَنْ تَعْرُضُوا عَلَيْهَا شَيْئاً، وَأَطْفِئُوا مَصَابِيحَكُمْ.
duas.meaning: When night falls, restrain your children (from going out) because at such time the devils spread about. After a period of time has passed, let them be. Shut your doors and mention Allah’s name, for verily the devil does not open a shut door, tie up your water-skins and mention Allah’s name, cover your vessels with anything and mention Allah’s name and put out your lamps.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim 267 · Al-Bukhari with Al-Fath 10/88 and Muslim 3/1595.
